items.html: The vapors that are fit for these seven kings emerged through the nails of the Raglayim, although the nails are ten, and the Nekudot that were broken are only ZAT [lower seven]. The thing is that there are also two kinds of posterior of Ima that were broken, which are nine phases, and the tenth is because in Keter, too, there was some flaw, which is its phase of NHY that entered and were Mochin to AVI, and they, too, were broken. Thus, there are ten phases corresponding to the ten vapors that emerged from the nails of his Raglayim, and the phase of the emergence of these ten vapors through his nails were all because they did not receive from the light of the upper Ozen. Hence, this reason caused all of this, and the revoking of the kings.
